skill.summary: Use Go2.gg API for URL shortening, link analytics, QR code generation, webhooks, and link-in-bio pages. Use when the user needs to create short links, track clicks, generate QR codes, set up link-in-bio pages, or manage branded URLs. Free tier includes short links, QR codes, and analytics. Requires GO2GG_API_KEY env var. QR code generation is free without auth.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release — URL shortening, link analytics, QR code generation, webhooks, link-in-bio galleries. Full API coverage with cURL + Python examples.
